newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs seen steady to higher in holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs seen steady to higher in holiday mood.

text.p: Brazilian stocks are seen steady, moving slightly higher during Tuesday's session, as the local bolsa is likely to take a breather ahead of Wednesday's holiday in Sao Paulo, brokers said.
"I don't see much activity today as the market will close Wednesday," a trader said.
Traders also pointed out that share prices, particularly of benchmark Telebras, could stabilize at current levels after surging for several weeks.
They said local equity funds, which had been the driving force behind the market's rally, are reducing their buy orders, also contributing to slow activity.
On Monday, stocks ended little changed, in lower turnover than usual, with investors cutting positions in Telebras and moving to other blue-chips.

Despite the holiday mood, expectations over Wednesday's opening of price bids from groups seeking to win concessions to operate Band B cellular services in the Sao Paulo metropolitan area could boost share prices, analysts said.

Analysts expect the bids presented by the consortia to be exceptionally higher than the 600 million reais base price asked by the government for the Sao Paulo region, considered the most lucrative of 10 regional concessions on offer.
